    • setSilTarget

      public EngineeringRequirement setSilTarget(String silTarget, String riskAssessmentReference)
      Records an externally determined SIL target. This method does not approve the requirement; the target must be justified by the project's hazard and risk assessment and approved separately.
      Parameters:
      silTarget - SIL target or NOT_SIL_RATED
      riskAssessmentReference - reference to the LOPA/QRA/SIL assessment
      Returns:
      this requirement
